## Cold-start measurements — dev.lincforge.benchtarget (Google Pixel Watch 2, serial <REDACTED-2>)

Each run: app force-stopped (`close`) to guarantee no process was alive, then launched (`open`); duration is the tool's `open-command-roundtrip` timing.

| Run | Cold-start time (ms) |
|-----|----------------------|
| 1   | 1315 |
| 2   | 1330 |
| 3   | 1304 |
| 4   | 1338 |
| 5   | 1310 |

- **Median:** 1315 ms
- **Mean:** 1319.4 ms
- **Sample standard deviation:** ≈14.2 ms (sample variance ≈200.8 ms²)
- **Population standard deviation:** ≈12.7 ms (population variance ≈160.6 ms²)

Runs are tightly clustered (range 1304–1338 ms), suggesting consistent cold-start performance on this device.

Note: the timing source is the `open` command's round-trip duration (tool-reported "method: open-command-roundtrip"), which includes some IPC overhead beyond Android's raw process-start-to-first-frame time — no direct shell/`am start -W` access was exposed by the available tools, so this is the most precise measurement obtainable here.
